# mgc_object_storage_objects (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of objects in a bucket.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mgc_object_storage_objects" "objects" {
  bucket = "my-bucket"
}

output "objects" {
  value = data.mgc_object_storage_objects.objects
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Name of the bucket.

### Read-Only

- `objects` (Attributes List) List of objects in the bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))

<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Read-Only:

- `etag` (String) ETag of the object.
- `key` (String) The name of the object (key).
- `last_modified` (String) Last modified date of the object.
- `size` (Number) Size of the object in bytes.
